entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Small metal automatons of Mirrodin devoted to duty, created by Memnarch; some have been altered by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The control-freakish former overseer of Mirrodin who went mad and created the myr.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who have taken and altered some of the myr with grafts and ichor reservoirs.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal world lit by five mana-suns, with environments such as the Razor Fields, the Quicksilver Sea, the Mephidross, the Oxidda Chain and the Tangle.

entities.name: Myr reservoirs
entities.description: Crater-like openings across Mirrodin's surface ringed with defunct myr husks, used to build myr legions.

entities.name: Sky Tyrant
entities.description: The red mana-sun, to which the goblins attribute mystical import.

entities.name: True Sun
entities.description: The fifth mana-sun, which the Tangle's elves honor as it passes directly over parts of the Tangle.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A goblin site over which the Sky Tyrant is celebrated.

entities.name: Tangle
entities.description: A dense, copper-treed forest of Mirrodin.

events.summary: Since Memnarch's defeat the myr have gained new purposes, devoting themselves to what needs doing.
events.quote: Since the defeat of Memnarch , they have gained new purposes

events.summary: The Phyrexians have taken and altered some of the myr.
events.quote: The Phyrexians have taken and altered some of the myr.

relations.quote: So what if they were creations of Memnarch

relations.note: altered myr with an anti-Mirran priority matrix
relations.quote: A decidedly anti-Mirran tilt to their priority matrix.
